_comment_file: Backend dependency manifest. This is the Node equivalent of a Python requirements.txt: 'npm install' reads it and installs everything into node_modules. JSON forbids // comments and npm rejects them, so explanations live in these _comment_* keys (npm ignores unknown keys) and in the README.
name: project-juventudes-backend
_comment_type: 'module' lets us use import/export syntax (ESM) in server.js and src/*.js instead of require().
_comment_scripts: 'npm run dev' = auto-restart on file changes (local development); 'npm start' = plain run (used by Render/Railway in production).
_comment_dependencies_day1: express = HTTP server/routing; cors = lets the GitHub Pages frontend call this API cross-origin; dotenv = loads .env into process.env; pg = PostgreSQL driver used by src/config/db.js.
_comment_dependencies_day2: bcrypt = one-way password hashing; jsonwebtoken = sign/verify the login JWT (also used to authenticate WebSocket handshakes); speakeasy = TOTP secret + 6-digit code (RFC 6238); qrcode = render the TOTP secret as a scannable QR; multer = parse multipart file uploads (profile photo).
_comment_dependencies_day4: socket.io = real-time WebSocket layer for live chat delivery; nodemailer = sends the mandatory chat notification email over SMTP; node-cron = schedules the daily 03:00 scholarship refresh; express-rate-limit = caps chat sends and login attempts (anti-spam / anti-brute-force).
_comment_devDependencies: nodemon = dev-only auto-reloader. smtp-server = dev-only local SMTP catcher used by scripts/dev-smtp.js so you can verify chat emails without sending real mail (Mailtrap/MailHog are equivalent hosted options). Neither is needed in production.
_comment_engines: Requires Node 18+ because the scheduler uses the built-in global fetch() (added in Node 18) to pull the scholarship source.
_comment_dependencies_day5: helmet = sets protective HTTP response headers (HSTS to force HTTPS, no-sniff, frameguard, etc.) as the Day 5 hardening pass.
